description: AURA-Flux is an open-source, physics-informed geospatial engine for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. By coupling NASA EMIT hyperspectral methane imagery with GEOS-FP wind reanalysis, AURA-Flux automatically transforms static orbital concentration maps into quantified, facility-attributed mass emission rates (kg/hr) with dynamic uncertainty bounds. Our pipeline bridges spaceborne remote sensing and ground-level action to tackle anthropogenic super-emitters in real time
